Sanctuary Gorilla Forest Camp · Bwindi Impenetrable National Park, Buhoma sector, Uganda

Sanctuary Gorilla Forest Camp

A premium choice for travelers who want the lodge itself to feel connected to the gorilla trekking landscape. It suits guests who value forest atmosphere, guide coordination, and avoiding unnecessary transfers on permit days.

Destination setting: Bwindi Impenetrable National Park. This is not a photograph of the accommodation.

Photos: Thomas Fuhrmann (CC BY-SA 4.0). Displayed images may be resized or cropped. Photo details.

Why stay here

A long-established forest camp positioned inside the Bwindi area for early gorilla-trekking starts and a quieter rainforest stay.

Confirm the trekking sector before booking. Bwindi permits are sector-specific, so the best lodge is the one that matches the assigned gorilla family departure point.

Key amenities

  • Forest setting
  • Gorilla trekking logistics
  • All-inclusive camp style
  • Guide coordination
